item.title: About
item.description: 陳勝舢 Sheng-Shan Chen 國立臺北科技大學 資訊工程系 博士 Sheng-Shan Chen holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Information Engineering from the National Taipei University of Technology. He was awarded a research grant under the National Science and Technology Council’s Graduate Students Study Abroad Program and conducted visiting research at the Department of Software Systems and Cybersecurity at Monash University, Australia. His research interests include deep learning applications, cybersecurity, and cyber threat intelligence analysis.
